reader.requirement: An EXIT PROGRAM statement executed in a program that no CALL activated (the run unit's main program) acts as no operation: execution continues with the next executable statement wherever the statement sits (own sentence, end of an IF, a PERFORMed paragraph, an inline PERFORM, a declarative, a SORT input or output procedure, after a CALL has returned).

edition-consulted.switches: ExitProgramArchaic2023 (COBOL0903 warning at 2023 only) and ExitProgramNotLast2002 (refuses at 85 an EXIT PROGRAM that a statement of its imperative sequence follows, X.5.4.3 SR1); neither changes the run-time arm
StatementRaising2002: EXIT PROGRAM RAISING refused at 85 (COBOL0879)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for GR1's run-time behaviour (the __asCalled gate is the same emitted code at every edition); 85 refuses the 2002 RAISING tail and 2023 adds an archaic warning
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f26_02 covers own sentence, the end of an IF and a PERFORMed paragraph; not covered: inline PERFORM, a declarative, SORT input and output procedures, after a CALL returned

probes.printed: BEFORE / AFTER 1 / IN IF / AFTER 2 / IN P-2 / AFTER 3, EXPECT MATCH
probes.expected: as the witness derives from GR1

probes.printed: LOOP K=3 / DECL 35 / DECL AFTER EXIT / AFTER OPEN 35 / OUT 1 / OUT 3 / AFTER SORT / SUB1 / AFTER CALL AND EXIT, EXPECT MATCH
probes.expected: inline PERFORM runs all 3 iterations; the declarative after the FAILED OPEN continues past EXIT PROGRAM and returns to the statement after the OPEN; the SORT input procedure releases both records and the output procedure returns both; after the called SUB1 returned (its own EXIT PROGRAM returns), the main's EXIT PROGRAM continues

probes.printed: --std 85: error COBOL0879 the GOBACK / EXIT ... RAISING phrase requires COBOL-2002; --std 2023: warning COBOL0903 EXIT PROGRAM obsolete (plus an operand error from the probe's EC-ALL without EXCEPTION)
probes.expected: the 85 format of EXIT PROGRAM (X.5.4.2) has no RAISING phrase, so it is refused at 85

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.5.4.4 GR1  (5.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: EmitExitProgram wraps the return in if (__asCalled); __asCalled is an instance flag set true only on the ICobolProgram.Call activation path in the emitted class and reset in its finally, so a main program entered by RunMain never returns on EXIT PROGRAM. At 85 a program cannot call the main program (no recursion), so the main is never under a caller's control.

refuter.evidence: r3a.cob at --std 85 has a main program WITH the INITIAL attribute, which the reader did not try. GR3's implicit cancel applies only to a called program, so the main must keep its data and its contained programs' state. Output: SUB 1 / AFTER EXIT CNT=1 / SUB 2 (no cancel of the main or of its contained SUB) / IN P-2 / IN P-3 / AFTER PERFORM (EXIT PROGRAM inside a PERFORM THRU range continues into P-3) / INNER / AFTER INNER IF / THEN / AFTER ELSE EXIT (EXIT PROGRAM as the ELSE of an unterminated IF continues with the next sentence) / IN P-4 / FELL TO P-5 (EXIT PROGRAM after GO TO falls through to the next paragraph). cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.4.4 GR1; OK §1985:X.5.4.4 GR3.
